name: brand-ai-readiness-audit
description: Agent Skill Marketplace that audits any website URL for AI discoverability and on-site engagement problems, and returns an evidence-backed report with severity, suggested fixes and priority.
author: Adobe University Hackathon 2026 submission

optional_dependencies.playwright: Enables the raw-HTML versus rendered-DOM comparison. Without it the audit still runs and the rendering-dependent checks report as not applicable.

runtime.network: outbound HTTP/HTTPS to the audited site only; no external service is required to resolve this manifest

skills.name: audit-orchestrator
skills.description: Single entrypoint. Validates the URL, runs the crawl and analysis skills, normalizes and deduplicates findings, computes severity, confidence, priority and the AI readiness score, and emits the schema-validated final report.

skills.name: crawl-render-audit
skills.description: Safe bounded read-only crawler and evidence engine. Collects HTTP status, redirects, robots.txt, sitemap, DOM structure, metadata, structured data, link graph, raw-versus-rendered comparison, page importance and business facts.

skills.name: discoverability-audit
skills.description: Detects AI discoverability failures across the discover, access, understand, extract and represent stages, from the evidence model.

skills.name: freshness-corroboration
skills.description: Checks entity naming consistency, contact-fact consistency between structured data and visible pages, and freshness signals, with normalization to avoid false positives.

skills.name: engagement-audit
skills.description: Detects on-site engagement failures: homepage orientation, page self-identification, navigation availability, missing next steps and interior pages that lose the visitor's context.

skills.name: reasoning
skills.description: Interprets and synthesizes deterministic audit evidence and findings. Produces grounded root-cause analysis, explains autonomous AI agent impact, maps cross-finding dependencies, and constructs a prioritized 3-phase strategic remediation roadmap without altering deterministic scores or severities.
